_comment: The eight Play screenshots, in listing order.
`source` is the untouched device capture in screenshots/raw/.
Every headline describes something the build actually does — see
store-text/screenshot-copy.txt for why each one is in the set.
cropTop/cropBottom are in SOURCE pixels on the 1080x2340 capture: they
strip the phone's status bar (clock, notification icons, battery) and the
bottom strip that can carry an ad banner, so all eight share one identical
viewport and no shot advertises someone else's app.
